notes.title: Important gameplay update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

After the release of "Locked in Temptation", it became clear that the gameplay is a bit too challenging or isn't clear enough on how points are earned and how to fully engage with the game. As a result, many players missed out on a significant portion of the content. 

To address this, we’ve decided to roll out an important update for the game. 

This update is designed to make the gameplay experience smoother and more accessible for everyone. Below, you’ll find the list of changes we’ve prepared to enhance your journey through the game.



Changelog:


 Changed the scoring system for Karen and Brenda on Day 4 (removed the reduction of points from Karen and Brenda due to Maria and Sarah's events).
 Choosing Sarah or Maria's Day 4 event will no longer block future Karen and Brenda events.
 Reduced the number of points (3 instead of 5) needed to unlock the final scene with Brenda on Day 6 (late evening/night).
 Overall, progressing through the game and unlocking scenes has become easier.


We hope your gaming experience will be more enjoyable!
